method.external_idea: Coherent joint probabilities, cross-market marginals, and anomalous collection prices; inspired by external racing price-model research and combinatorial market constraints.
method.average: 50:50 mixture of coherent p3p_joint and p2t_joint
method.selection: Given formation candidates, maximize expected equal-stake 3連単 basket ROI from indicated external pool projection; thresholds applied before outcome observation.
method.ticket_space: Actual A×B×C Cartesian formation per candidate; union of two proper formations, remove duplicate exact bets.
method.comparison_family: One existing base and seven hold/shift modifications; does NOT explore all possible formations or prove global optimum.
method.selection_parameters: Grid min estimated equal-stake ROI, min synthetic odds, max points. 2021-24 training->2025 test, 2021-25 training->2026H1 test.
method.risk: No-bet if no training grid surpasses break-even after minimum exposure (200 pooled, >=25 each year).
method.financial_returns: Exactly 100 yen per unique point; actual result must exactly be among paid bets, no credit for partial wins.

limitations: Historical FINAL odds only. No T-15 snapshots; cannot claim pre-close executability.
No race-level alignment of quotes from the independently pooled markets beyond archived final data.
The conditional within-triple and within-top-two uses trifecta market, so external projections are not independent forecasts.
Market priors are NOT calibrated true probabilities; price discordance is a screening indicator, not proof of market error.
Uses only eight existing candidate shapes (usually large), even with 8–32 point caps. Arbitrary shape optimization remains open.
Selection over many rules risks multiple comparisons; held-out years previously used in other projects, therefore not virgin data.
Any found positive ROI needs independent future period and proper wager-sized settlement.
Original research code, models, running purchase rules and websites unchanged.
